scientific_domain: Rheology / Mori-Zwanzig Prony Memory Kernel Identification

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Adding more relaxation modes or refining the time grid is sufficient to meet both public targets.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: Four through six continuously optimized modes all gave equilibrium moduli near 11.36–11.47 against 12.5; two modes instead missed the stress target at 3.05–3.15% relative RMSE.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: The finite strain hold leaves slow memory, equilibrium response, and affine drift correlated; extra fast modes can lower training residuals without resolving that separation.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep the hereditary recurrence and affine drift projection, and test whether modest spectral regularization improves stability on held-out ramp, hold, and oscillatory blocks.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: A uniform preference for faster relaxation stabilizes equilibrium-modulus recovery across the specified time range.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: At penalty strength 2, the 7 s synthetic slice improved from 23.6% to 16.9% modulus p90 error, but the 18 s slice worsened from 26.0% to 33.1%, with signed mean bias rising from +5.1% to +18.4%.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Shortening a genuinely slow relaxation mode transfers stress into the equilibrium term; the affine drift can absorb part of the resulting discrepancy on the observed time window.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Preserve long modes and first test whether the observed spike structure can recover useful measurements without imposing a stronger spectrum prior.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: Hard BIC order selection on calibration stress preserves the relaxation modes needed for step prediction.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: On the 35 ms three-mode slice, the selected two-mode fit omitted the fast mode and had 7.79–7.95% stress error in three inspected replicates; removing the time penalty did not restore the mode.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Slow calibration ramps weakly excite the fast mode, while the prediction steps amplify the error caused by dropping it.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Test less aggressive order selection and average plausible spectra, while comparing long-mode bias separately.
